# Security

If you find something in aGoldenDiagnose that could harm the people who run it (a way for a file, a game or a web page to make it do something it shouldn't, a leak of personal details, anything like that), please **don't open a public issue**.

Report it privately instead: on this repository's **Security** tab, choose **Report a vulnerability**. Only the maintainer sees it.

Please include the version, the system (Windows or Linux) and how to make it happen. Don't include personal details you don't need to.

Only the newest version gets fixes, so please check you're on it first (**Check for updates** at the top right of the app).
